purpose: Make the PLE passport's exact source tensor ABI machine-verifiable without converting the generic ModelLake census into a shard-header scan or reading source payloads.

selected_header_capture.contract: Exact index-bound names only; non-symlink containment; one canonical witness validator; at most 16 names, 8 shards, and 524288 aggregate header bytes; exact descriptor digests; zero tensor payload bytes; trusted immutable ModelLake root only.

static_trait_projection.contract: Consumes the canonical selected-header validator before projection, carries manifest/index identity, and leaves default ModelLake traits config/name-only.

passport_query.contract: Uses the canonical selected-header validator, binds witness manifest/index to static identity, and makes absence a static mismatch while malformed or tampered evidence is an error.

passport_catalog.change: The PLE passport distinguishes configured layer id 2 from zero-indexed tensor block 1 and binds exact shard_0 BF16 shape, complete tensor-name manifest, and selected index identity.

assessment.policy: The targeted witness proves only one static source ABI. It does not synthesize any dynamic control or authorize a method execution.

preserved_boundaries.generic_modellake: scan_specimen never calls the selected-header capture; persisted generic traits contain no selected tensor headers.
preserved_boundaries.source_teacher: WITHHELD_MISSING_MACHINE_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION; a static tensor header is not a PLE-inclusive source greedy/state teacher.
preserved_boundaries.source_root: The static helper is scoped to the trusted immutable ModelLake source root; it is not a hostile-tree source-admission primitive.
preserved_boundaries.runtime: No source model, GPU, Metal, provider, Hawkingd, Web, or Kimi process was launched or restarted.
preserved_boundaries.modellake: No ModelLake file, index, artifact, or source payload was mutated.

validation.focused_tests: 99 passed: Foundry passport query, architecture recognizer, ModelLake lineage/index, and PLE source-formula controls.
validation.static_actual_source_witness: passed: one exact PLE shard header, 2400 header bytes, zero tensor payload bytes, exact descriptor digest, complete tensor-name manifest, selected index identity, and PLE header predicate matched.
validation.name_only_negative_control: passed: the same source traits without a selected-header witness yielded WITHHELD_STATIC_TRAIT_MISMATCH for PLE.
validation.aggregate_header_cap_control: passed: target-only capture refuses over-8-shard requests and reserves the remaining aggregate header budget before every later shard read.
validation.malformed_witness_controls: passed: stale descriptor hash, zero header accounting, over-16 descriptor count, over-8 unique shard count, and outer-manifest tampering were rejected before assessment.
validation.identity_rebinding_controls: passed: a changed complete tensor-name manifest or selected index identity yields WITHHELD_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; absent optional witness remains WITHHELD_STATIC_TRAIT_MISMATCH.

prior_passport_integration.relationship: This is an additive stricter witness over the earlier names/config passport projection; it does not overwrite its historical evidence.

next_safe_action: The machine owner provisions the existing trust anchor and detached V2 authorization, then the already-owned lease transaction captures one fresh PLE-inclusive source/native boundary. Do not substitute this static shape witness for that teacher or start a replay.
claim_boundary: This receipt proves a payload-free selected source header and fail-closed passport recognition only. It does not prove source output/state parity, PLE compression, a complete NR, EBPW, native TPS, capability, deployment, Pulsar promotion, or Kimi retirement.
